F01.title: PostgreSQL latency and connection disruption
F01.risk: A database outage must not duplicate a committed transfer or corrupt accounting.
F01.mechanism: Actual API JDBC traffic crosses Toxiproxy; the guardian applies bounded latency and disconnects the allowlisted PostgreSQL proxy.

D02.title: Idempotency payload mismatch
D02.risk: A changed recipient under an existing idempotency key is accepted instead of rejected.
D02.mechanism: A guarded disposable-database variant omits the fingerprint rejection in ledger.execute_command. The same HTTP/SQL test runs before, during and after the variant.

F02.title: RabbitMQ duplicate delivery
F02.risk: Redelivery must not post settled money again.
F02.mechanism: Publish the identical persisted payment-request envelope twice through the isolated real broker, observe consumer acknowledgements, and compare independent financial snapshots.

D06.title: Duplicate-message financial effect
D06.risk: A retry is mistaken for fresh economic intent and spends money again.
D06.mechanism: In disposable settle_event only, cut inbox/state guards on settled replay and assign a fresh journal operation identity. The real broker sends the identical event twice; the unchanged independent before/after ledger oracle detects extra debits.

D01.title: Same-key replay creates fresh operation
D01.risk: Retry after uncertainty spends money a second time.
D01.mechanism: The isolated command function remaps each incoming key to a new identity. Identical HTTP replay then creates another transfer and journal, detected by unchanged operation-identity and independent balance oracles.
